title: Preliminary flood insurance study and rate maps.
officialText:
Until such time that the department by rule adopts revised FEMA FIS 360497 and FEMA FIRMS 360497 with a final effective date later than May 1, 2014, the following flood hazard maps and supporting data are also adopted as a referenced standard and declared a part of this appendix.
1. FEMA PFIS 360497.
2. FEMA PFRIMs 360497.
